description.en: Understand what web automation can prove, choose worthwhile candidates, and frame them as repeatable checks.
description.id: Kenali apa yang bisa dibuktikan web automation, pilih automation candidate yang bernilai, lalu rumuskan sebagai repeatable check.

outcome.en: Given a manual scenario, decide whether and where to automate it, then define its state, action, and observable evidence.
outcome.id: Dari skenario manual, tentukan apakah automation layak dan feedback layer mana yang tepat. Lalu rumuskan product risk, starting state, user action, serta observable evidence-nya.

description.en: Read semantic HTML, accessible identity, DOM context, and browser evidence before writing automation.
description.id: Pahami HTML semantik, accessible name, konteks DOM, dan evidence dari browser sebelum menulis web automation.

outcome.en: Inspect a live web UI, identify a control's meaning and context, and define the observable evidence an automation test should use.
outcome.id: Periksa Web UI yang aktif, kenali makna dan konteks sebuah kontrol, lalu tentukan observable evidence yang perlu dibuktikan automated test.

description.en: Bridge a manual test idea to a small, reviewable Playwright test: run it, change its data safely, preserve async dependencies, and read TypeScript feedback.
description.id: Jembatani ide test manual ke test Playwright kecil yang mudah direview: jalankan, ubah datanya dengan aman, jaga dependency asynchronous, dan baca feedback TypeScript.

outcome.en: Given a manual QA scenario and a small Playwright test, explain which lines express test intent, Playwright API calls, JavaScript logic, and test data; make one safe change, diagnose the result, and review TypeScript claims against runtime evidence.
outcome.id: Dari skenario QA manual dan test Playwright kecil, jelaskan mana yang merupakan intent test, pemanggilan API Playwright, logic JavaScript, dan test data; lakukan satu perubahan aman, telusuri hasilnya, lalu cek klaim TypeScript terhadap bukti runtime.

description.en: Turn test intent into an owned locator contract, narrow repeated UI without hiding ambiguity, and maintain CSS or XPath fallbacks with a documented reason.
description.id: Ubah intent test menjadi kontrak locator yang ownership-nya jelas, persempit repeated UI tanpa menyembunyikan ambiguitas, lalu rawat fallback CSS atau XPath dengan alasan yang terdokumentasi.

outcome.en: Given a live UI and test intent, choose a locator contract that preserves the intended user, domain, or engineering meaning; prove when a match should be unique or plural; diagnose zero or multiple matches; and explain when a CSS or XPath fallback is warranted.
outcome.id: Dari live UI dan intent test, pilih kontrak locator yang menjaga makna user, domain, atau engineering yang dimaksud; buktikan kapan match harus unique atau plural; diagnosis nol atau beberapa match; lalu jelaskan kapan fallback CSS atau XPath memang diperlukan.

description.en: Turn a user's workflow into state-aware Playwright actions, separate action readiness from product outcomes, and synchronize results across browser surfaces.
description.id: Ubah user workflow menjadi Playwright action yang menyatakan state, pisahkan kesiapan action dari product outcome, lalu sinkronkan hasil di berbagai browser surface.

outcome.en: Given a user workflow, choose actions that express the required state, distinguish action readiness from application success, and capture the correct current-page or one-time browser outcome without fixed sleeps.
outcome.id: Dari sebuah user workflow, pilih action yang menyatakan required state, bedakan kesiapan action dari keberhasilan aplikasi, lalu tangkap outcome yang tepat di page saat ini atau one-time browser event tanpa fixed sleep.

description.en: Choose sufficient observable evidence and turn business rules into a focused, non-duplicative test portfolio.
description.id: Pilih observable evidence yang cukup lalu ubah business rule menjadi test portfolio yang fokus dan tidak duplikatif.

outcome.en: Given a product risk, design a focused scenario and use the smallest sufficient set of assertions to prove its business-relevant outcome.
outcome.id: Dari sebuah product risk, rancang skenario yang fokus lalu gunakan kumpulan assertion terkecil yang cukup untuk membuktikan business-relevant outcome.

description.en: Separate browser sessions, own mutable state, and diagnose failures through evidence instead of symptom-masking patches.
description.id: Pisahkan browser session, tentukan ownership untuk mutable state, lalu diagnosis failure lewat evidence tanpa symptom-masking patch.

outcome.en: Given an intermittent or state-dependent failure, control each test’s starting state, identify the cause from execution evidence, and verify a repair under the conditions that exposed it.
outcome.id: Saat menghadapi intermittent atau state-dependent failure, kontrol starting state setiap test, temukan penyebab dari execution evidence, lalu verifikasi repair pada kondisi yang mengeksposnya.

description.en: Choose the smallest useful abstraction, make test lifecycles explicit, and encode suite policy without hiding product intent.
description.id: Pilih abstraction terkecil yang berguna, buat test lifecycle explicit, lalu encode suite policy tanpa menyembunyikan product intent.

outcome.en: Given a growing suite, localize meaningful change with a justified abstraction, assign clear ownership and scope to test dependencies, and review configuration as executable policy.
outcome.id: Saat suite berkembang, lokalkan meaningful change lewat abstraction yang justified, tentukan ownership dan scope test dependency dengan jelas, lalu review configuration sebagai executable policy.

description.en: Reproduce the test system in CI, select coverage from risk, preserve actionable evidence, and prove a focused capstone.
description.id: Reproduce test system di CI, pilih coverage dari risk, simpan actionable evidence, lalu buktikan lewat focused capstone.

outcome.en: Given a valuable product risk, deliver a reproducible feedback contract with intentional coverage, actionable evidence, owned failure handling, and a capstone claim whose limits you can explain.
outcome.id: Dari product risk yang bernilai, hasilkan reproducible feedback contract dengan intentional coverage, actionable evidence, ownership failure yang jelas, serta capstone claim yang batasnya bisa kamu jelaskan.
